title: Alternative Accessibility Solutions for Wheelchair-bound Residents in HDB Blocks where Lift Upgrading Programme Remains Unfeasible
what_it_is: Alternative Accessibility Solutions for Wheelchair-bound Residents in HDB Blocks where Lift Upgrading Programme Remains Unfeasible

sections.label: HDB Lift Upgrading Programme
sections.summary: HDB has implemented LUP in over 5,000 blocks, with about 99% of blocks now having direct lift access or LUP benefit, and a Lift access Housing Grant of up to $30,000 for remaining households.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Since then, the Housing and Development Board (HDB) has successfully implemented LUP in more than 5,000 blocks which were originally built without direct lift access.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Today, around 99% of all HDB blocks were either built with direct lift access or benefited from the LUP.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We recognise that there remains about 1% of blocks which have been unable to benefit from LUP due to high costs or technical constraints.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For households in such blocks, they may tap on HDB’s Lift access Housing Grant, or LHG in short, of up to $30,000 to help them buy a replacement flat with direct lift access.

sections.label: Stair-lift considerations
sections.summary: Stair-lift issues have been looked at, with considerations including safety and technical constraints.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Yes, we have looked at issues relating to stair-lifts.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: There are considerations like safety, technical constraints, in regard to these.

sections.label: No stair-lifts installed
sections.summary: No stair-lifts have been installed yet, unless as part of LUP specifications, and fire safety and technical constraints must be considered.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: From my recollection, no stair-lifts have been installed yet, at this moment, unless there are certain specifications as part of the LUP.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, I think what is key is that while we install infrastructure or devices, we have to look at some aspects in terms of fire safety and other aspects like the technical constraints that may be there.
